subject: By-Election - Chicoutimi-Le Fjord
precis: Order directing that a writ of election do issue in order to fill the vacancy in the House of Commons for the electoral district of Chicoutimi-Le Fjord, in Quebec, with polling to take place on August 31, 2026.
